company_name: FUJIFILM ELECTRONIC MATERIALS KOREA CO., LTD.
semiconductor_relevance: High — FUJIFILM Electronic Materials Korea specializes in photoresist and ancillary chemicals critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: FUJIFILM Electronic Materials Korea is a leading manufacturer and supplier of photoresist and microelectronic materials for the semiconductor industry. Established in 1983, the company focuses on delivering high-quality, innovative chemical solutions that enhance semiconductor fabrication processes.
capabilities: COLOR MOSAIC® color resist material for micro-color filter fabrication

regional_presence.Korea: The company operates as a 100% owned subsidiary of FUJIFILM Corporation in Korea, focusing on the semiconductor materials market.
